name: OD9 — offda9.com (Off Da Nine)
_local_base_url_note: Arms the pre-deploy LOCAL render gate (added 2026-08-27, the day the engine's WSL Host-header fix made that gate actually work — before that it silently skipped itself on this workstation). All six smoke tests are same-host page renders, so all six run locally; a runtime fatal in any of them now stops the deploy BEFORE prod instead of being discovered by prod smoke after the sync.
_deploy_enabled_note: Enabled 2026-08-11 after the --dry diff was reviewed line by line. That review was not a formality: it caught that api/drip/weekly_lovelogic_sender.php (cron-driven, Mondays 9 AM) was NEWER ON PROD than in the repo, so deploying would have reverted a live weekly broadcast to a stale build using the wrong PHP interpreter. Fixed in 5b023d1 before enabling. The diff was also cut from 22 creates / 16 changes to 16 / 15 by removing five root-level duplicates of live senders; of the 15 remaining changes, 13 are prod-side CRLF being normalized to LF (verified zero real content difference with --strip-trailing-cr) and 2 are repo-ahead comment updates.
_topology_note: Connects AS the owning account. The retired tools/deploy.py SCP'd each file to /tmp and sudo-installed it as ultimaterage because 'the SSH user cannot write offda9's web root directly' — that is obsolete: /home/offda9/.ssh already holds an automation key, both ~/.ssh/id_rsa_automation and ~/.ssh/freshthaband_key authenticate directly as offda9@, the account owns its writable docroot, and rsync is present. So od9 needs NO engine changes; plain rsync-as-owner works exactly like the platform repos.
_remove_remote_note: The customer/ portal was five 6-line wrappers that require_once files from /home/freshthaband/public_html/shared-platform/. offda9 cannot read another cPanel account's home, so every one of them returned HTTP 500 to any visitor — verified 2026-09-01, all four reachable URLs. They only ever worked while od9 lived inside the freshthaband account, and cross-account filesystem includes cannot be made to work; if od9 ever wants a customer portal it needs a real design (it is already a platform tenant at od9.freshthaplatform.com). Nothing linked, routed or sitemapped them. Deleted from the repo in the same change. Paths are relative to ssh.remote_base (/home/offda9).

mappings._note: Whole-tree sync. The repo root IS the docroot since the public/→root restructure (commit 801668f). rsync runs WITHOUT --delete, so prod-only runtime content (guide-videos/, library/ media uploaded out-of-band, cache/, data/) is never removed.

skip_always._doc: Human-readable summary of the exclude list above — why each class never ships.
skip_always.credentials: config/database.php, config/mail.php, config/sp-credentials.php, dashboard/includes/config.php and the *.config.php glob (platform.config.php, mail.config.php, secrets.config.php, api/v1/pulse_secret.config.php). Several of these are TRACKED IN THE REPO with local-dev values AND live on prod with real credentials — deploying the repo copy would overwrite prod's working config. The *.config.php glob deliberately does NOT match *.config.example.php, so the examples still ship.
skip_always.server_config: php.ini, .user.ini — cPanel/server level, prod-only, correctly absent from the repo.
skip_always.workstation_only: tools/, .claude/, docs/, tests/, migrations/, *.py — never web-served.
skip_always.runtime_artifacts: logs/ (70 .eml mail-outbox captures from smoke runs), cache/.
skip_always.legacy_never_deploy: dashboard/includes/db.php, founding_patron_launch_sender.php and .htpasswd are carried over from the retired tools/deploy.py's `never_deploy` list. The first --dry run of this config would have shipped all three — porting that list is not optional when replacing a deployer.
skip_always.diagnostics: check_db.php and check-admin.php are DB/admin diagnostics that the first dry run would have newly created in a public webroot — the same class as the _phpinfo.php found serving on freshthaband.com. They stay local.

pre_deploy._note: Brought to gate parity 2026-09-01, following this block's own instruction: each gate was RUN against od9 first, and is enabled only where it proved meaningful and either passed or had its findings fixed. od9 had been the least-gated repo in the fleet while carrying a database-backed dashboard, Discord OAuth and a drip mailer.
pre_deploy._first_run_findings: guardrail_lint reported 20 errors: five 6-line customer/ wrappers require_once-ing files from /home/freshthaband — another cPanel account offda9 cannot read, so all four reachable URLs returned HTTP 500. Deleted (see remove_remote). schema_usage found 5 phantom columns, every one in api/drip/processor.php: od9_drip_log had no step_id/email_to, od9_drip_enrollments had no completed_at, both its UPDATEs keyed on a non-existent `id` instead of enrollment_id, and the customers fallback filtered on a discord_user_id that table does not have. The drip mailer could not log a send, advance a step, or complete a sequence. All fixed in the same change.
pre_deploy._brand_lint_why_off: brand-lint encodes the FRESH palette (#D4AF37 gold on #0A0A0A, Playfair/Inter). od9 is a different brand with its own visual language, so the gate would report hundreds of 'violations' that are correct design. Turning it on would need an od9 palette definition first.
pre_deploy._cron_contract_why_off: `crontab -l` for offda9 is EMPTY and the repo has no cron/ directory — there is nothing for this gate to check, and an empty gate is a green light that means nothing. Revisit if od9 gains scheduled work.
pre_deploy._orphan_scan_why_absent: od9 defines ZERO PHP classes (243 files, all procedural), and orphan-caller-scan checks for zero-caller classes and methods. It would scan nothing and report clean — the vacuous-pass shape this ecosystem keeps getting bitten by.
pre_deploy._phpunit_why_absent: od9 has no test suite. The engine's phpunit gate refuses on 0 tests executed rather than passing vacuously, so enabling it would simply block every deploy. A suite is the real prerequisite.

post_deploy_smoke_tests._note: CLEAN-URL PIN, not a page pin: /atlas works only through the .htaccess RewriteRule, and this URL is printed in a published YouTube description. The 2026-08-27 catch-up deploy shipped a rule-less .htaccess over prod's hotfixed one and this link 404'd for ~20 minutes while smoke passed 6/6 — because every test pinned a real file and none pinned a REWRITE. An .htaccess regression must fail the deploy, not be discovered by a viewer.

REDIRECT PIN, followed end-to-end: /epk on the brand domain 302s to od9.freshthaplatform.com/epk, the platform-rendered press kit (Phase 24B). follow_redirects is the default, so this asserts the WHOLE chain — the .htaccess rule exists AND the redirect target actually renders a press kit. Both custom domains 404'd on /epk until 2026-08-27 while the platform subdomains served fine; a brand-domain URL someone puts on a flyer must not depend on nobody testing it.

_smoke_note: must_contain 'Off Da Nine' on the apex proves we reached OD9 and not a parked domain or a misrouted edge — status+200 alone cannot tell those apart.

backup._exclude_note: Large out-of-band media and runtime dirs are omitted from the pre-deploy tar to keep it small and fast. They are also never written by the deploy (excluded from the mapping, and rsync runs without --delete), so nothing that changes goes un-backed-up.

_provenance: Authored 2026-08-11 as part of the od9 repo↔prod reconciliation. Replaces the 234-line repo-local tools/deploy.py, whose web_src pointed at a public/ directory that no longer exists (so it was already broken). RETIRE deploy.py only after a --dry run here is reviewed and deploy_enabled is flipped. Two capabilities of the old deployer are NOT yet in the canonical engine and remain open: Cloudflare cache purge (cf_zone_id/cf_api_token) and opcache reset.
